### Onboarding Summary: Amanda Cook

**Welcome!**  
We are excited to have Amanda Cook join the team. Below is an overview of key onboarding steps and essential information.

- **Full Name:** Amanda Cook  
- **Department:** *(To be confirmed)*  
- **Start Date:** *(To be confirmed)*  
- **Manager:** *(To be confirmed)*  
- **Role Title:** *(To be confirmed)*

#### 2. Required Documentation (First Day)
- Completed I-9 and W-4 forms  
- Signed employment offer letter  
- Direct deposit authorization form  
- Emergency contact information

#### 3. System Access & IT Setup
- Email account and laptop will be provisioned before start date.  
- Access to internal systems (HR portal, time tracking, collaboration tools) will be granted on the first day.

#### 4. Orientation Schedule
- **Day 1:** HR orientation (benefits overview, company policies, code of conduct)  
- **Day 2–3:** Department introduction, team meetings, and job-specific training  
- **Week 1:** Initial project assignments and buddy/mentor assignment

- Health, dental, and vision insurance – enrollment window opens within 30 days of hire.  
- 401(k) enrollment available after 90 days.  
- Company-paid life insurance and optional supplemental coverage.

#### 6. Training & Compliance
- Mandatory harassment prevention training (online, due within 7 days)  
- Data privacy and security training  
- Department-specific compliance training (if applicable)

#### 7. Next Steps
- Confirm start date and schedule with HR.  
- Complete pre-boarding forms via the candidate portal.  
- Reach out to the assigned HR contact with any questions.

---
